maya_marketing: Heads-up  Sundial Health interview wrapped this morning. Recording + transcript + redaction checklist in Drive: https://drive.redwood/sundial. Theyre a HIPAA customer so we need extra sign-offs on any patient-level language. Target embargo: Sept 9.

owen_growth: Great. Growth wants the hero to focus on reliability + privacy. Sales wants webinar registrants tagged `sundial-web` and routed to the enterprise demo queue.

li_prod: We captured a clean anecdote about switching to Redwood Private and removing noisy tail spikes during morning batch windows. Ill produce a sanitized P95 chart (no PHI) if Sundial approves.

haley_legal: Important: we need a BAA copy and explicit marketing permission that covers anonymized charts. Please attach the signed media release and any legal contact emails. Ill draft a short approval note for their counsel.

maya_marketing: Uploaded release + quote draft (four variants) and a redaction checklist: https://drive.redwood/sundial/quotes. /cc @haley_legal

sam_design: Once copy is locked Ill mock a hero banner and a 30s clip optimized for LinkedIn. Need final CTA and embargo to schedule promo.

nora_sales: Routing notes: add utm_campaign=sundial_launch; tag registrants with `enterprise|healthcare`. Follow-up cadence: AE outreach within 24h for attendees who submit a trial request. Also want the gated appendix with the full sanitized chart for sales-only access.

compliance-bot: Reminder: assets to compliance review by timestamp 1771200000 (Sept 7 20:00 UTC). Attachments without compliance sign-off will be blocked from publishing.

haley_legal: Quick guidance: no patient anecdotes, no raw numbers tied to patient counts. If they want a percent reduction claim, we need an approval email from their finance or data team and confirmation that the metric excludes PHI. Ill send a short approval template to their counsel.

li_prod: We can produce two chart variants: 1) sanitized axes-only visual (no ticks), 2) gated appendix with labeled axes but aggregated counts (if they sign off). Which do we prefer for top-funnel?

owen_growth: Use the sanitized visual for public materials and promote the gated appendix in the webinar for qualified leads. That gives us a conversion hook without exposing sensitive data.

maya_marketing: Derek (Sundial) okayed a short executive line: "Redwood Private helped us stabilize inference during rush windows." Hell route legal sign-off for charts by Thursday.

haley_legal: On BAA  confirm weve got it attached. Also confirm whether their counsel requires source attribution for the sanitized numbers. If yes, include a methodology blurb in the gated appendix.

sam_design: Ill prepare hero mocks with two CTAs: "Register for the Sundial webinar" and secondary "Request the gated appendix (sales)". Will share PNGs by Sept 6.

nora_sales: Webinar rec: Tues Sept 9 at 10am PT to cover EMEA overlap. Enable gated replay for nurture flows. Routing: auto-tag and push to SFDC queue `Sundial_Webinar_Attendees`.

maya_marketing: Plan: lock quote + legal OK by Sept 5, finalize assets by Sept 6, open registration Sept 2, embargo publish Sept 9 morning. Ill post final assets and the registration snippet here. :seedling:
